description: This file defines the ApiDemos class, an Android ListActivity that displays a list of sample activity categories and handles navigation among them based on intent data. It queries installed activities matching certain categories, organizes them into a list, and manages user interactions to launch specific demos.

classes.name: ApiDemos
classes.description: Main activity class that displays a list of sample demos and handles navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves path extra, and sets up the list adapter with demo items.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Generates the list of demo items based on installed activities matching the SAMPLE_CODE category.

methods.name: activityIntent
methods.description: Constructs an intent to start a specific activity given its package and component name.

methods.name: browseIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to browse deeper into the demo hierarchy, passing the path as extra.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a demo entry with a name and intent to the data list.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on list items to launch the selected demo activity.
